author: OpenAI
description:
In Seoul, OpenAI and Fast Campus brought together learners in their 50s and 60s for a hands-on AI education program with ChatGPT and Codex.

Fast Campus is using OpenAI tools to design practical learning experiences where learners can move from an idea to something they can build. In the film, the Fast Campus team shares how ChatGPT and Codex are being used in the program, and what that makes possible in the classroom.

The film also captures the energy in the room: curiosity, focus, and the excitement of learning by building. Learners explored how AI can connect to their own experience, work, creative projects, business ideas, and next chapters.

AI should be accessible to people at every stage of life and work, so everyone can learn and build at their own pace.
title: Learning with AI at Any Stage of Life | Fast Campus x OpenAI
